dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: I'm in charge of repairs here in the shipyard. Everyone calls me Wrench Wang.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: That's not my real name, mind you. Although it sounds a bit foolish, if that's what everyone likes to call me, then so be it! Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Tell me about making boat repairs.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Even if your vessel is on its way to the bottom, I can still fix it — just as long as you're not going down with it, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Repairing ships is much more interesting than building them. What I'm working on isn't just the ship itself, it's also the memories of its crew.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Even if a ship is completely refitted from the hull to its rigging, it'll still feel like the same old ship that you've always known.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Just like the handkerchief Siyu gave me. Even though it's full of patches, I'd never trade it for a new one.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Siyu's my childhood sweetheart. We were always stirring up trouble together, and the adults would always give us an earful, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: After we grew up, I joined the fleet for a few years before returning to the shipyards as the best repairman these docks have ever seen!

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: As for her, she fulfilled her dreams of becoming the bride of a real Prince Charming.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: They say that time waits for nobody, and nothin' is more true for childhood sweethearts, hahahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: ...Oh, look's like me eyes have sprung a leak. Apologies, must be that salty sea breeze, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Agh, clearly she should have been mine... *cries*
